title: Termwise open-cover short exact sequence with prescribed adjunction mates
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], R its underlying ring sheaf, U,V open subsets with U∪V=X, and W=U∩V. Let RU,RV,RW be restriction functors on sheaves of R-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], assumed additive. Let SU,SV,SW be additive left adjoints to these restrictions with chosen adjunctions aU,aV,aW. For any cochain complex K of R-modules, write KU=SU(RU K), KV=SV(RV K), KW=SW(RW K), all computed termwise. Let εU:KU→K and εV:KV→K be the degreewise counits. Let cU:RU TU≅RW and cV:RV TV≅RW be the canonical overFunctorMap comparison isomorphisms for the nested restrictions TU,TV to W. There exists a complex morphism f:KW→KU⊕KV such that in every degree n, (f≫fst)^n is the aW-transpose of cU(K^n)⁻¹≫TU(ηU(RU K^n))≫cU(SU RU K^n), and (−(f≫snd))^n is the analogous V transpose. The composite f≫(εU,εV) is zero and 0→KW→KU⊕KV→K→0 is short exact in the category of complexes. No localization or derived object is used in this assertion.

proof.text: Construct the nested mate natural transformations from overFunctorMap and the adjunction units. Naturality of inverse homEquiv gives their naturality; apply them degreewise to build complex morphisms iU and iV. Set f=biprod.lift iU (-iV). The biproduct projection identities and the component definition prove both required mate formulas.

Prove each nested mate followed by its counit equals the overlap counit, using homEquiv naturality, overFunctorMap naturality and the right triangle identities. Apply this degreewise to the two complex maps. Expanding biprod.lift_desc proves the complex composite is zero and its degreewise counterpart is zero. Apply the module-level mate short exactness theorem with this proved zero relation to K.X n in each degree.

The evaluation functor preserves the biproduct. Its mapBiprod comparison, with identity isomorphisms at the two ends, identifies the evaluated short complex with the module-level one. Transport short exactness along this isomorphism and use HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact.

theorem open_cover_mate_complex_shortExact (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (hR : R = (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf)
    (U V : Opens X) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    [(overFunctor.{u} R U).Additive] [(overFunctor.{u} R V).Additive]
    [(overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).Additive]
    (SU : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (SV : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over V) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (SW : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U ⊓ V)) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    [SU.Additive] [SV.Additive] [SW.Additive]
    (aU : SU ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R U) (aV : SV ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R V)
    (aW : SW ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V))
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} R) ℤ) :
    let KU := (SU.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      (((overFunctor.{u} R U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)
    let KV := (SV.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      (((overFunctor.{u} R V).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)
    let KW := (SW.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      (((overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)
    let εU := (aU.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counit.app K
    let εV := (aV.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counit.app K
    let cU := overFunctorMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)
    let cV := overFunctorMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    ∃ (f : KW ⟶ KU ⊞ KV),
      (∀ n, (f ≫ biprod.fst).f n = (aW.homEquiv _ _).symm
        (cU.inv.app (K.X n) ≫
          (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)).map
            (aU.unit.app ((overFunctor.{u} R U).obj (K.X n))) ≫
          cU.hom.app (SU.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R U).obj (K.X n))))) ∧
      (∀ n, (-(f ≫ biprod.snd)).f n = (aW.homEquiv _ _).symm
        (cV.inv.app (K.X n) ≫
          (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)).map
            (aV.unit.app ((overFunctor.{u} R V).obj (K.X n))) ≫
          cV.hom.app (SV.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R V).obj (K.X n))))) ∧
      ∃ hz : f ≫ biprod.desc εU εV = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk f (biprod.desc εU εV) hz).ShortExact
